questions.q: What are the two ways to lead your life, according to the article?
options: Speaking or listening
Not quite. The article says: Simply passing your time, or using it meaningfully.
Simply passing your time, or using it meaningfully
The first wastes life.
Working or resting
Not quite. The article says: Simply passing your time, or using it meaningfully.
Earning or spending
Not quite. The article says: Simply passing your time, or using it meaningfully.
questions.rationale: One is to simply pass your time. The other is to use your time meaningfully.

questions.q: What will we take with us of the things accumulated in life?
options: Our houses
Not quite. The article says: Nothing.
Our wealth
Not quite. The article says: Nothing.
Our titles
Not quite. The article says: Nothing.
Nothing

questions.rationale: After we die, we will not take any of the things we have accumulated when we were alive.
